text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Arima Kinen. Satono Diamond has her eye on three people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, who she has admired since before starting at Tracen Academy. Tokai Teio, McQueen's long-time rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, there's Kitasan Black, who she has always dreamed of catching up to and overtaking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond vows to beat all of them and make her dream come true!
